bio: FamilySearch has 'Conradt Birgert', born in 1588 at Fockenberg-Limbach, married to Anna Eva Jacob (b. 1593), and father of Elisabetha (1618-1685) ([R4-S1]). It carries the line back to Hans Konrad Birckhert (1535-1605) and Barbara Ibelheupt, without sources visible for that generation. His name appears in the indexed 1642 marriage of his daughter to Caspar Grub ('Conradt Birkhert') and in a Lutheran baptism entry ([R4-S1]).
openQuestions: FamilySearch names his wife (Anna Eva Jacob) and parents (Hans Konrad Birckhert and Barbara Ibelheupt); all need records.
